Data extract: 2026-10-30 (pre-database-lock extract)
Prepared by: svc-analytics, reviewed by F. Ritter (biostat)

Files
- ae_subject_level.csv : subject-level AEs, MedDRA v27.0 coded. 1,412 randomized (941 revatimod, 471 placebo). Includes investigator causality and onset/resolution dates.
- lab_values.csv : serial chemistry (ALT, AST, ALP, total bilirubin, CK), scheduled visits plus unscheduled.
- protocol_stub_P301.md : abbreviated protocol. Full protocol in eTMF.

Efficacy (ADAS-Cog13, week 78, LS mean change from baseline)
- Revatimod: -4.1 (SE 0.31)
- Placebo: -1.2 (SE 0.32)
- Placebo-adjusted difference: 2.9 points favoring revatimod, p<0.0001

Notes
- Site 0412, subj 0412-007: atorvastatin 40 mg since 2019, baseline ALT upper-normal. Causality listed as 'possible' in CSV, investigator comment illegible in scan.
- ALT or AST >3x ULN at any visit: revatimod 30/941 (3.2%), placebo 4/471 (0.8%). Maximum observed 3.1x ULN.
- Site 0931: two subjects with elevations resolved after dose interruption; dechallenge timing inconsistent with dosing diary in 1 case. Under query.
- 17 of the 30 treated cases were flagged by site as likely confounded (prior hepatic history, concomitant atorvastatin or acetaminophen use); the other 13 have no site attribution. Dechallenge was done in 9, rechallenge in none.
- Lab file contains 11 values with unit mismatch (U/L vs µkat/L) at site 0208. Not yet corrected.
- No subject met the Hy's law combined threshold (ALT or AST >3x ULN with total bilirubin >2x ULN).
- Protocol stub section 7.4 (hepatic monitoring) is a placeholder, see eTMF version 4.0.

Status: DB lock scheduled 2026-11-20.
